caption: The drawing depicts a large, ornate urn or samovar with a lid and two gracefully curved handles on either side. The object is rendered in grayscale pencil or graphite, giving it a monochromatic appearance. The urn has a tall, pointed lid with a small finial at the top. There is decorative beading along the lid's edge and a band of intricate patterns just below the lid on the main body of the urn. An oval medallion encircled by a decorative border is visible on the front of the urn's body. A spigot or tap, also detailed with shading, extends from the lower left side, ending with a curved handle for pouring. The urn stands on a rounded, raised base, which itself is set on a square platform with short legs at each corner. The object is centered within a simple rectangular border, and the paper background is a light beige color. In the lower left corner, there is a handwritten label that appears to be the artist's name.
title: Silver Urn
